data.rationale: The proposal gets the same procedure (Find a Park, Search by Activity or Topic, pick options, Search) but leaves out the optional state parameter, treats the filter type as a tab rather than a dropdown, and names its parameters vaguely, so an automation would need guesswork on the filter control and the state input.
